f2_source_observed.source_object_note: UnifiedDBAuthorityRef is a reference and does not itself prove that a persisted UnifiedDB row was loaded

external_primary_sources.relevant_mechanism: a read transaction observes a stable database snapshot; WAL mode provides snapshot isolation
snapshot handles can identify historical WAL read states when SQLite is built with SQLITE_ENABLE_SNAPSHOT
same-connection comparison can detect intervening commits from other connections; it is not a durable global revision or row identity
statement/row tracing provides execution observability but does not authenticate semantic typed-object consumption
authorization occurs while statements are compiled/prepared at operation/table/column scope rather than proving exact row values consumed
changesets capture mutation lineage; they do not attest SELECT-row consumption
pre-update hooks concern mutations rather than SELECT consumption
cryptographically verified reads are a useful adversarial reference pattern, but importing a second database/ledger would be architecturally disproportionate for this F2 boundary

source_level_findings: SQLite can establish a stable read snapshot, but no single inspected standard primitive proves that one exact canonical row was materialized as one exact F2 typed object and consumed by one exact restart/planner invocation.
PRAGMA data_version is useful only as a concurrent-change guard and must not be promoted into row identity or durable snapshot truth.
Authorizer, trace, session and pre-update mechanisms each cover useful adjacent observability or mutation surfaces but do not independently establish semantic row-to-object consumption.
A full cryptographically verified external datastore is stronger than required and risks a competing truth/provenance substrate.
The smallest architecture-compatible candidate is therefore an F2-native load receipt emitted at the canonical UnifiedDB read adapter after successful row fetch and typed-object construction.
fail_closed_nonclaims: receipt existence alone does not prove physical target runtime execution
data_version alone is not row-load attestation
pre-load/source-object hashing alone is not consumed-row evidence
application receipt is not tamper-proof against a malicious privileged process
E1 does not grant F2-WP-901 integration, runtime, physical-grid or whole-system credit
counterhypothesis: Existing source-object authentication is already sufficient and no explicit row-load receipt is necessary.
counterhypothesis_note: Current F2 source explicitly declares persisted_row_attestation=NOT_OBSERVED, so current source-object authentication cannot by itself support the stronger persisted-row-load claim.
